product_overview: Impact Health 2.0 is a responsive healthcare web application that presents a public-facing healthcare website with informational pages, patient support content, blog browsing, and contact inquiry submission. The product is designed to provide a modern, accessible experience for patients and visitors across devices.
core_goals: Browse the healthcare website and navigate between public information pages
Read about the company, privacy policy, and patient support offerings
Explore blog content through listing and search-oriented browsing
Submit contact inquiries through the public contact form

features.name: Site Navigation
features.description: Allows visitors to move between the main public pages of the healthcare website.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Click a navigation link for another public page -> See the selected page load
Navigate to /about -> Use site navigation to return to the homepage -> See the homepage content
Navigate to /blogs -> Use site navigation to move to the contact page -> See the contact form page load

features.name: Homepage Browsing
features.description: Lets visitors view the main homepage content and learn about the healthcare service through featured sections.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Review the hero section and service overview -> Scroll through the homepage sections -> See the patient support, testimonials, FAQ, and call-to-action content

features.name: About Us Page
features.description: Provides company background, mission, values, and team information for visitors who want to understand the organization.
user_flows: Navigate to /about -> Read the company overview -> Review mission, vision, and core values -> View the team and healthcare commitment content

features.name: Patient Support Programs
features.description: Shows information about patient support offerings, including program details, eligibility, benefits, and enrollment prompts.
user_flows: Navigate to /patient-support-programs -> Read the program information -> Review eligibility requirements and benefits -> View the enrollment call to action

features.name: Blog Browsing
features.description: Lets public visitors browse healthcare blog content and explore available posts and categories.
user_flows: Navigate to /blogs -> Browse the list of blog posts -> Open a blog post to read its details -> Return to the blog listing and continue browsing categories
Navigate to /blogs -> Search for a blog topic -> Review the filtered results -> Open a relevant post to read more

features.name: Contact Inquiry Submission
features.description: Allows visitors to send a message to the organization using the contact form.
user_flows: Navigate to /contact -> Fill in the full name, email address, phone number, organization, and message -> Submit the form -> See the message sent success indicator
Navigate to /contact -> Leave a required field empty -> Submit the form -> See form validation feedback

features.name: Privacy Policy Viewing
features.description: Provides visitors with the company privacy policy in a readable format.
user_flows: Navigate to /privacy-policy -> Read the privacy information -> Review the policy content on the page
